newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland invites new bids for Ruch newsstand chain.
newsitem.headline: Poland invites new bids for Ruch newsstand chain.

text.p: Poland on Friday invited new bids for the newsstand chain Ruch SA, after calling off talks with a consortium led by French Hachette when it failed to improve its offer, the treasury ministry said.

The ministry said in a newspaper announcement it invited bids for no less than 10 percent of shares in Ruch by March 28 and said selected investors would receive information about the firm starting from April 3.
By April 18 the investors would have to present their initial offers.
The announcement paves the way for a domestic consortium led by Universal to bid for the chain which owns 17,000 kiosks nationwide and controls 65 percent of Poland's press distribution market.

Hachette, which had signed an initial agreement with the treasury ministry late last year on a purchase of 75 percent of Ruch, has threatened unspecified action against the Polish government if it cancels the deal.
The group has so far not commented on the ministry's decision to cancel the earlier agreement.
